nodes.name: Lemma 3.2
nodes.statement:
For the Lyapunov function $\hat{g}(\theta_n)$ we have $$
\hat{g}(\theta_{n+1})-\hat{g}(\theta_{n})\leq h(\hat{g}(\theta_{n})),
$$ where $h(x):=\alpha_0\sqrt{2 L}\left(1 + \frac{\sigma_0 L}{2\sqrt{S_0}}\right)\sqrt{x} + \left(1  + \frac{\sigma_0\alpha_0 L}{2\sqrt{S_0}}\right)\frac{ L\alpha_0^2}{2}$ and  
$h(x) < \frac{x}{2}$ for any $x \geq C_0$ with some constants $C_0$.
nodes.section: Figure 1: The structure of the proof of 3.1

nodes.name: \text{Property} 3.3
nodes.statement: Under~2.1~ass_g_poi:i3, the gradient sublevel set $J_{\eta}:=\{\theta \mid \|\nabla g(\theta)\|^{2}\le \eta\}$ with $\eta >0$ is closed and bounded. Then, by~2.1~ass_g_poi:i, there exist a constant $\hat{C}_{g} > 0$  such that $\hat{g}(\theta) < \hat{C}_{g}$ for any $\theta \in J_{\eta}$.

nodes.name: \text{Proposition} 3.3
nodes.statement:
Let $F$ be a continuous globally integrable vector field. Assume that
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textnormal{(A.\arabic*)},leftmargin=*]
    \item Suppose $\sup_n \|x_n\|< \infty,$ 
    \item For all $T > 0$
    \[
    \lim_{n \to \infty} \sup \left\lbrace \left\lVert \sum_{i=n}^{k} \gamma_{i}U_{i} \right\lVert : k = n, \dots, m(\Sigma_{\gamma}(n) + T) \right\rbrace = 0,
    \]
    where 
    \[\Sigma_\gamma(n):=\sum_{k=1}^{n}\gamma_{k}\ \ \text{and}\ \ m(t):=\max\{j\ge 0:  \Sigma_{\gamma}(j)\le t\}.\] 
    \item \(F(V)\) is nowhere dense on \(\mathbb{R}\), where \(V\) is the fixed point set of the ODE: \(\dot{x} = g(x)\).

\end{enumerate}
Then all limit points of the sequence \(\{x_{n}\}_{n\ge 1}\) are fixed points of the ODE: \(\dot{x} = g(x)\).

nodes.name: Theorem 5.1
nodes.statement:
Suppose that 2.1 ass_g_poi:i$\sim$ass_g_poi:i2, 2.2 ass_noise:i, 5.1, 5.2 coordinate_i_1 hold. Consider RMSProp. We have
\[\mathbb{E}\left[\sup_{n\ge 1}g(\theta_{n})\right] < +\infty.\]
nodes.section: Figure 3: The proof structure of RMSProp

nodes.name: Lemma D.4
nodes.statement:
Under 2.1 ass_g_poi:i$\sim$ass_g_poi:i2, 2.2 ass_noise:i, 5.2 coordinate_i_1, consider RMSProp. We have $\forall\ 0<\delta\le 1/2$
\[\sum_{t=1}^{+\infty}\sum_{i=1}^{d}\mathbb{E}\left[\frac{\zeta_{i}(t)}{t^{\delta}}\right] \leq \mathcal{O}(1).\]
nodes.section: Figure 3: The proof structure of RMSProp

nodes.name: Lemma D.5
nodes.statement:
Under 2.1 ass_g_poi:i$\sim$ass_g_poi:i2, 2.2 ass_noise:i, 5.2 coordinate_i_1, consider RMSProp. We have
\[\sup_{t\ge 1}\left(\frac{\Sigma_{v_{t}}}{\ln^{2}(t+1)}\right)<+\infty\ \ \text{a.s.},\]
nodes.section: Figure 3: The proof structure of RMSProp

nodes.name: Lemma D.6
nodes.statement:
Under 2.1 ass_g_poi:i$\sim$ass_g_poi:i2, 2.2 ass_noise:i, 5.2 coordinate_i_1, consider RMSProp. We have
\[\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{i=1}^{d}\frac{(\nabla_{i}g(\theta_{t}))^{2}}{t^{\frac{1}{2}+\delta}\ln(t+1)}<+\infty\ \ \text{a.s.} \,\, \text{where} \,\,  0<\delta\le 1/2. \]
nodes.section: Figure 3: The proof structure of RMSProp

nodes.name: Lemma D.7
nodes.statement: Under 2.1 ass_g_poi:i$\sim$ass_g_poi:i2, 2.2 ass_noise:i, 5.2 coordinate_i_1, consider RMSProp. The vector sequence \(\{v_{n}\}_{n \geq 1}\) converges almost surely.
